The leaderboard container (data-testid='leaderboard') must display exactly these 5 rows in this exact top-to-bottom order: rank 1 Carol score 390; rank 2 Dave score 230; rank 3 Alice score 100; rank 4 Bob score 100; rank 5 Eve score 95. Verify this without performing a manual page reload.

    At the end of the test, respond with the following JSON:
    {
        "status": "pass" | "fail",
